subject: Overlap mitigation + shadow-host handback for Nebula x Redwood co-sell demo
messages:
From: Samir Khan <ops@nebula.ai>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-14T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Nebula x Redwood co-sell: combined marketplace demo (conflict with SI dry-run)

Hi Marcus / Kimberly / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro — Nebula is excited to get the joint marketplace demo in front of our mutual GSI and a set of SRE evaluators next week. Draft agenda attached (Nebula_Redwood_CoSell_Agenda_v1.pdf) and a quick network diagram.

Quick heads up: our SI partner (Stratus) has an internal technical dry-run booked in the same two-hour window on Oct 22 that overlaps with the customer-facing slot. That dry-run is for the SI runbook and hardware checks; there will be technical folks on both calls. We want to avoid duplicate recordings and confused handoffs.

As a starting point: can Redwood own the customer-facing recording? If not, can we agree a "shadow-host" approach so the SI dry-run runs first (30–45m), then a 15m buffer, then the customer demo?

Proposed customer-facing window: Oct 22, 13:00–14:00 PDT. SI dry-run: Oct 22, 12:00–13:00 PDT. If that sequencing doesn't work we can swap.

Also: any constraints on where recordings must live (Redwood Drive vs Nebula tenant vs AWS Marketplace listing)? We prefer Redwood Drive for single-pane tracking, but happy to follow your compliance needs.

--
Samir Khan
Director, Partner Ops — Nebula AI
ops@nebula.ai
Attachments: Nebula_Redwood_CoSell_Agenda_v1.pdf, network-diagram-amp.png

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <ops@nebula.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nebula x Redwood co-sell: combined marketplace demo (conflict with SI dry-run)

Thanks Samir — appreciate the flag and the clean agenda.

Short answer: we can own the customer-facing recording and surface it on the Redwood Drive link you see in related_links, provided we get sign-off from the SI on distribution. Operationally I'd like to avoid two simultaneous calls. My proposal:

- Shadow-host plan: SI dry-run (12:00–12:45 PDT) -> 15-minute buffer (12:45–13:00) for context handoff -> Customer demo (13:00–14:00)
- Who leads the handoff: we suggest the SI closes their dry-run and shares a 3-slide "runbook highlights" with the customer on the first 5 minutes of the customer call; Redwood will take the first half of the demo (architecture + observability) then Nebula leads the feature walkthrough.
- Recording owner: Redwood (we'll capture and upload to the shared Drive); Nebula can download the master and re-host if needed. We'll also keep the meeting chat log.

Related operational asks: please confirm whether Stratus (Carol) needs explicit consent before we upload recordings to the Drive. If yes, can you loop them in? If no, we'll proceed and mark the recording visibility as restricted inside Redwood's folder.

Finally — small ask: can the demo include a 7–10 minute segment on cost/observability controls? The customer specifically asked about token economics + inference telemetry.

I'll hold the proposed slot tentatively; Kimberly/Vanessa, can you confirm availability and a shadow-host handback owner?

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior GTM PM, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-14T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nebula x Redwood co-sell: combined marketplace demo (conflict with SI dry-run)

+1 on the shadow-host plan. I'm available Oct 22 12:00–14:30 PDT, so sequencing as you suggested works for me. I can be the shadow host for the first customer segment (13:00–13:30) and handback to Vanessa for the Nebula-led feature deep dive.

Two operational notes:
- Rohan, can your team (ops) provision the meeting recording retention policy to "30 days restricted" for this folder? We may need to extend if the account requests archival for compliance.
- If Stratus needs explicit approval for Redwood to host, we'll need a one-line approval in email from Carol; Samir, can you loop her in?

I updated the agenda with a 10-minute observability/cost block (see inline in the attached — I kept the same filename for version control). If we get sign-off I'll push final agenda to the Drive link.

—Kimberly
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Samir Khan <ops@nebula.ai>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Cc: Carol Nguyen <carol@stratus.io>, Partner Ops (AWS) <partners@aws-example.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nebula x Redwood co-sell: combined marketplace demo (conflict with SI dry-run)

Thanks all — confirmed.

Carol (cc): could you reply with a one-line approval that Redwood may host the customer-facing recording to the shared Drive? If you'd prefer Nebula host, tell us and we'll flip.

We will stick to the sequencing: Stratus dry-run 12:00–12:45 PDT -> buffer 12:45–13:00 -> Customer demo 13:00–14:00 PDT. Redwood will capture the recording and upload; Nebula will mirror to our tenant for our internal archive.

Links: Zoom link above; I've also put a placeholder HubSpot note (HS-57321) with the agenda.

Samir
Director, Partner Ops — Nebula AI
